headline: Hatzivasileiou: The EU should create room for fiscal flexibility; Mitsotakis' initiative is a matter for European discussion
summary: Deputy Foreign Minister Tasos Hatzivasileiou called for the greatest possible fiscal flexibility in Europe so governments can support households against energy costs. He spoke at a meeting of Mediterranean EU ministers in Croatia.
why: EU fiscal rules limit how much member governments can spend on energy support, shaping the scope of national budgets across the bloc.
